description: Bangladesh - Access Roads inside Rohingya Refugee Camps in Cox's Bazar is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by WFP - World Food Programme. The dataset contains roads accessible by vehicles and trucks across the refugee camps in Cox’s Bazar Bangladesh, smaller routes and footpaths are not included, satellite imageries and ground verification was used in order to collect and consolidate this dataset. Coverage: Bangladesh. The portal files it under the publisher WFP - World Food Programme. Its tags are camp coordination and camp management-cccm, cyclones-hurricanes-typhoons, geodata, logistics, needs assessment. It offers 2 resource(s) in KML, SHP. The portal shows 2025-05-05 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
